profile.name: Iván Jiménez
profile.summary: Software developer with a background in IT infrastructure and cybersecurity, focused on penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, and network security. Building practical experience through hands-on security labs and technical projects.

projects.title: Missions / Projects
projects.subtitle: Cybersecurity labs and software projects that reflect my hands-on experience and technical profile.

items.name: Web Application Security Lab
items.description: Hands-on analysis and controlled exploitation of web vulnerabilities in deliberately vulnerable applications, focusing on HTTP traffic and application behavior.

items.name: Vulnerability Exploitation Lab
items.description: Controlled exploitation of multiple vulnerable services and systems deployed in reproducible environments, covering different attack vectors and exploitation scenarios.

items.name: WPA2 Wireless Security Assessment
items.description: Controlled WPA2 security assessment involving authentication capture, handshake and PMKID analysis, deauthentication and credential resilience testing.

items.name: MITM & Traffic Interception Labs
items.description: Set of labs focused on communication interception and traffic analysis in controlled networks using Man-in-the-Middle techniques and interception proxies.

items.name: Security Monitoring & Threat Detection
items.description: Set of labs focused on security monitoring, event analysis and threat detection using endpoint telemetry and network traffic analysis.

items.name: SOC Incident Response Lab
items.description: Deployment and integration of an incident management and analysis platform in a cloud environment using TheHive, Cortex and MinIO.

items.name: Network Hardening & Monitoring
items.description: Set of labs focused on network hardening, segmentation and monitoring, including VLANs, DMZ design, firewall rules and secure remote access through WireGuard.

items.name: Digital Forensics & Incident Analysis
items.description: Analysis of digital evidence from systems, memory, Android devices and network captures, including activity reconstruction and technical reporting.

items.name: WhatTheGame
items.description: Video game discovery web application developed with Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, Firebase and integration with an external API.
